title: StrategyCritiqueResult
description: Model-facing critic output (OQ-03 section 4): a possibly empty list of typed findings. It holds no host provenance, usage, applicability, approval, closure, severity, treatment or finding_source. Parsing labels every returned finding model_judgement; the registered policy assigns treatment. An empty list is not a pass.

CritiqueFinding.title: CritiqueFinding
CritiqueFinding.description: category is the one primary category that names the defect. method_advice covers optional preferences only, never a concrete defect. method_refs are supplied rule IDs; evidence_refs are evidence IDs from the request. affected_elements are JSON Pointers to definition elements whose behaviour or values the concern bears on; the list may be empty.

FindingLocation.title: FindingLocation
FindingLocation.description: Where the defect is. contract and definition: an element of the registered version, named by pointer. A defect such a version cannot contain is located in its cited sources, the supplied evidence, its rationale or expected-effect claims, or its requested tests; pointer then names the item where one applies.
